note: BDEW/VDEW Standardlastprofile Strom as published coefficient tables. Each edition is a separate file because the two editions differ in normalisation basis and in day-type/season granularity; their values must never be mixed. CoeffTable is the only reader; nothing here is recomputed or smoothed.

1999.publisher: VDEW (Verband der Elektrizitätswirtschaft e.V.), Frankfurt am Main, 1999
1999.authors: BTU Cottbus, Lehrstuhl Energiewirtschaft (Meier, Fünfgeld, Adam, Schieferdecker)

season_rule.source: primary_document pp. 12 (§ seasons), verbatim in EVIDENCE.md §4

daytype_rule.text: All public holidays of the supply area carry the Sunday profile; 24.12. and 31.12. carry the Saturday profile unless they fall on a Sunday.

profiles.G2: Gewerbe mit starkem bis überwiegendem Verbrauch in den Abendstunden

dynamisation.t_definition: day number in the calendar year, 1 = 1 January, 365 (366 in leap years) = 31 December

1999.applies_to_engine_year_range: any Gregorian year; the rule is date-based, not year-specific

2025.publisher: BDEW Bundesverband der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft e.V., Berlin
2025.authors: BTU EVU Beratung GmbH, commissioned by BDEW

daytype_rule.text: Working days (WT), Saturdays (SA), Sundays and public holidays (FT); the state-specific public holiday calendar per BDEW definition applies.

profiles.H25: Haushalt, top-down from 62 distribution-system operators 2018/2019; inherent moderate prosumer influence; dynamisation required
profiles.G25: Gewerbe allgemein, from about 2,000 iMSys series 2022/2023 of ten DSOs; single profile for all commercial customers; dynamisation NOT applicable
profiles.L25: Landwirtschaftsbetriebe, derived from the old L0; single profile; dynamisation NOT applicable
profiles.P25: Kombinationsprofil PV (net household import with PV), 400 iMSys series 2022/2023; dynamisation required
profiles.S25: Kombinationsprofil PV + Speicher (net household import with PV and battery), 200 iMSys series 2022/2023; dynamisation required

dynamisation.quote: Bei Ausrollen der Profile ist die Dynamisierungsfunktion anzuwenden!
dynamisation.source: coefficient_workbook, sheet header rows of H25/G25/L25/P25/S25

2025.applies_to_engine_year_range: any Gregorian year; month-based, so no leap-day special case

holidays.legal_basis: Sonn- und Feiertagsgesetze der Länder, as summarised by the BMI: https://www.bmi.bund.de/DE/themen/verfassung/staatliche-symbole/nationale-feiertage/nationale-feiertage-node.html
holidays.bmi_verbatim: Durch die Sonn- und Feiertagsgesetze der Länder sind jedoch neun Feiertage bundeseinheitlich gesetzlich geschützt.
holidays.state_holidays: not shipped: BDEW defines the calendar per Bundesland, and this repository holds no first-hand Land holiday statutes. Callers supply extra dates explicitly; the engine applies exactly the nine nationwide holidays plus whatever the caller declares.

usage_boundaries: A standard load profile is a synthetic shape for metering and balancing, not a measurement of the customer's site. It must not be presented as measured consumption.
The 1999 and 2025 editions are not interchangeable: different normalisation basis (1,000 kWh/a vs 1 Mio kWh/a), different season granularity (3 vs 12) and different day types.

P25 and S25 publish net household import with PV (and battery) self-consumption already netted out; BDEW requires that self-consumption to be settled separately on the supplier side. They belong to the net_import boundary, never to gross_load.

Undynamised, P25 and S25 integrate to 94.9% and 88.7% of the published basis; dynamised they return to about 99.9%. Both readings are measured and recorded, so neither is mistaken for a scaling defect.
The 2025 profiles were calibrated on 2018-2023 data and BDEW states their balancing quality will decline as PV build-out continues (primary document §2.4).

Only the nine nationwide holidays are applied. BDEW defines the calendar per Bundesland and this repository holds no first-hand Land holiday statute, so a caller that knows its Bundesland passes the extra dates explicitly.
Every annual integral this module produces is reported back to the caller, never silently renormalised.
